items.title: Data Center Design Manager
items.description: About the Team OpenAI's Compute organization builds and operates the infrastructure that powers frontier AI training and inference. Our data center engineering teams develop the technical standards and infrastructure required to deploy compute at unprecedented scale across both self-built and partner-operated environments. We work across civil, structural, mechanical, electrical, construction, and infrastructure delivery to develop data center designs that are reliable, scalable, and optimized for speed. About the Role We are seeking a Data Center Design Manager to coordinate the design and delivery of infrastructure for large-scale AI deployments. You will bring engineering disciplines and external design partners together to translate infrastructure requirements into coordinated, buildable design packages. You will manage design milestones, resolve cross-discipline interfaces, and keep technical decisions aligned with project requirements. Working with engineering, construction, commissioning, operations, and hardware teams, you will help preserve design intent from early planning through construction and turnover. The focus is design execution, technical coordination, and clear ownership of design decisions. Key Responsibilities - Manage design scope, deliverables, milestones, and dependencies from concept development through detailed design and construction support. - Coordinate civil, structural, architectural, mechanical, electrical, controls, and physical network interfaces across data center buildings and campuses. - Translate owner and hardware requirements into coordinated design criteria, working with discipline leads to resolve gaps and competing requirements. - Lead multidisciplinary design reviews; track comments, decisions, technical risks, and actions through resolution before design release. - Evaluate design changes with engineering and delivery partners, making impacts on reliability, safety, cost, schedule, and maintainability clear. - Coordinate external architects, engineering consultants, developers, and equipment suppliers to maintain design quality and meet agreed deliverables. - Partner with construction and commissioning teams on constructability, sequencing, RFIs, submittals, field issues, and design changes. - Maintain design documentation and handoff requirements, and incorporate field and operational lessons into reusable standards and reference designs. Qualifications - Bachelor's degree in engineering, architecture, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience. - Experience managing multidisciplinary design for data centers, mission-critical facilities, or comparable complex infrastructure. - Technical understanding of data center infrastructure and the interfaces among power, cooling, controls, structures, and physical networks. - Experience taking coordinated design packages from early planning through detailed design and construction support. - Experience coordinating external design consultants, engineering specialists, and construction partners. - Ability to read technical drawings and specifications, identify interface gaps, and work with discipline experts to resolve them. - Strong written and verbal communication, disciplined issue tracking, and sound judgment when balancing technical requirements with delivery constraints. Preferred Skills - Experience with hyperscale data centers, high-density AI or HPC infrastructure, or other rapidly evolving mission-critical environments. - Familiarity with liquid cooling, high-density power distribution, and the integration of changing compute hardware requirements into facility designs. - Experience managing design reviews, quality checks, and technical change control across concurrent projects. - Experience with modular or prefabricated infrastructure and design approaches that improve constructability and deployment speed. - Familiarity with BIM, model coordination, clash detection, and engineering document-control tools. - Experience supporting commissioning readiness, as-built documentation, and handoff to operations. - Experience adapting reference designs and engineering standards to site-specific constraints across a portfolio. - Professional engineering or architecture licensure, or relevant design and project management credentials. items.location_text: San Francisco, CA | New York City, NY
items.description: About Anthropic Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems. About Anthropic Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems. About the role Anthropic’s Applied AI team helps the world’s largest organizations put Claude to work. As a Cybersecurity Specialist on Applied AI, you’ll be part of an overlay team of domain experts who sit alongside our enterprise account teams and bring deep security expertise to the accounts where it matters most. You won’t own an account. You’ll be the security expert the account team pulls in to win and grow the most important security conversations: helping CISOs and security leaders see where Claude can take on real security work, then guiding them from early pilots to durable, production workloads. You’ll cover a portfolio of enterprise accounts across regulated industries like financial services, insurance, and healthcare, strategic accounts like semiconductors (IP protection, industrial control systems, export controls), and digital natives and public sector agencies, each with its own threat model. How this team works You partner with account executives, account architects, and generalist Applied AI engineers, who own the customer relationship and the broader technical engagement. You bring the security depth they don’t have time to build. You work across many accounts at once, so the playbooks, reference implementations, and evaluation approaches you build are reused across the field, not just for one customer. You are the connection point between the field and Anthropic’s Product, Research, and Engineering teams, turning what you see in customer security programs into product feedback. You work alongside ISVs, systems integrators, and managed security providers who already serve these customers, enabling them where they own the engagement rather than competing with them. Responsibilities Join account teams to understand a customer’s security program, identify where Claude can do meaningful security work, and turn that into a technical plan and business case Serve as the security-domain technical advisor on strategic enterprise accounts, from discovery through deployment Move customers from one-time code scanning to sustained security workloads: application security in the SDLC, continuous automated penetration testing, alert triage and investigation, and threat intelligence that answers “does this new vulnerability affect us, and where” Build and maintain reference implementations, harnesses, and evaluation approaches, and help customers adapt them to their own environments and controls Run workshops and hands-on sessions where customer security teams use Claude on their own code and workflows Equip partners to deliver Claude-powered security outcomes, with a clear line between what Anthropic delivers and what partners deliver Speak credibly to every audience, from appsec engineers to CISOs and executives, including how to explain the value and risk of security work in business terms Define and track adoption depth for each security workload across your accounts, and work with Product and Engineering on the telemetry to measure it Write the playbooks and best practices the rest of the field can reuse, including how Claude complements the security tooling customers already own Develop reference customers who can speak to the value they’re realizing Stay current on frontier LLM capabilities and the new classes of vulnerabilities and attacks they surface Travel occasionally to customer sites for workshops and technical deep dives You may be a good fit if you have 5+ years in security roles, with hands-on depth in at least two of: application security and secure SDLC, offensive security and penetration testing, detection and response, or threat intelligence and vulnerability management Experience in a technical customer-facing role (Solutions Architect, Sales Engineer, security consultant, TAM), or on a security team where you had to win investment from leadership Experience with large enterprise customers and complex, multi-stakeholder buying cycles, including working alongside the vendors and partners already in the account The ability to translate between security teams, engineering teams, and executives Comfort with Python, CI/CD, and cloud environments, plus hands-on experience using LLMs for security work such as code review, vulnerability discovery, triage, or investigation A love of teaching and a collaborative approach to working across teams and balancing competing priorities The annual compensation range for this role is listed below. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. Annual Salary: $300,000 — $400,000 USD Logistics Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices. Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this. We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team. Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings. How we're different We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills. The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences. Come work with us! Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage: Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

items.location_text: United States, Ireland, United Kingdom, Canada
items.description: ABOUT ELEVENLABS ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology. We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always. We have expanded from voice into three main platforms: - ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale. - ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages. - ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models. Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you. HOW WE WORK - High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy. - Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you. - AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations. - Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models. - Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location. WHAT WE OFFER - Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible. - Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities. - Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend. - Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose. - Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy. - Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend. ABOUT THE ROLE We are looking for a Global Technical Talent Lead to own hiring across Engineering, Product, Design, Research, and Growth worldwide. Reporting to the Head of Talent, you will lead Talent leaders and partner with senior engineering, growth, and research leaders to build the teams powering ElevenLabs. Your mandate is to bring cohesion to hiring strategy, execution, and standards across this portfolio, with accountability for hiring quality, pace, and predictability. - Turn engineering priorities into a deliverable global hiring plan. Partner with functional leaders to translate product roadmaps, research priorities, and workforce plans into hiring plans. Own Talent capacity allocation, planning, forecasting, and reporting. - Build and lead a cohesive global recruiting organization. Coach and develop Talent leaders, establish clear accountability for results, and allocate resources across disciplines and markets as priorities change. Build shared practices for talent mapping, sourcing, candidate experience, and closing while developing the specialist expertise each talent market requires. - Define and uphold the hiring bar across technical disciplines. Partner with functional leaders to define excellence by role and level, translating it into clear success profiles, rigorous assessment, and consistent hiring decisions. Equip the team to engage exceptional talent, credibly represent the work, and help candidates understand the opportunity and impact. - Make hiring performance visible and predictable. Establish regular hiring reviews with functional and senior leadership to track delivery, surface risks, and resolve decisions. Use market intelligence and funnel data to advise on location strategy, skill availability, and interviewer capacity. Partner with Talent Ops to improve systems, tools, processes, and the use of AI, so hiring is demonstrably faster and more efficient. REQUIREMENTS - You have led Talent through hypergrowth at a company that grew 3x or more in two years, owning delivery of hundreds to thousands of hires annually across multiple regions and time zones. You have a proven track record of managing teams of Talent leaders and delivering business critical hiring across engineering, research, growth, design, and product disciplines. - You can earn the trust of senior engineering, growth, product, design, and research leaders, partner on hiring decisions, and advise on talent availability, location, role scope, and assessment. You have deep expertise in the varying talent markets. - You have translated changing business and technical priorities into credible hiring forecasts and recruiting capacity plans. You use pipeline, conversion, hiring lead times, and interviewer capacity to distinguish achievable commitments from emerging risks and guide resource decisions. - You combine strong people leadership with deep recruiting expertise. You have raised team performance through coaching, partnered with hiring leaders to improve assessments, and maintained a high hiring bar at scale. You can personally unblock a difficult search or help close an exceptional candidate. LOCATION This role is remote and can be executed globally. Preference for candidates based in US East or GMT timezones. #LI-Remote We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

items.title: BI Engineer
items.description: ABOUT THE ROLE We’re looking for a BI Engineer to join our Business Intelligence Engineering team at LeoVegas Group. You’ll work across the full BI stack, from modelling data in BigQuery to building the dashboards senior leaders use to run a multi-brand, multi-jurisdiction iGaming business. This is a hands-on engineering role with real ownership. We treat our reporting as data products, built to scale and to last, and we’re moving our BI platform to Sigma, so you’ll help shape how we build on it from early on. If you enjoy writing clean SQL, solving messy data problems, and seeing your work shape decisions across the business, we’d love to hear from you. WHAT YOU’LL DO - Design, build, and maintain scalable presentation-layer datasets using SQL, dbt, Python, Airflow, and BigQuery on GCP. - Choose the right materialisation strategies and follow CI/CD practices to keep our models reliable, performant, and cost-efficient. - Design and maintain a semantic layer with governed, consistent metric definitions that power both dashboards and AI-driven self-service, so stakeholders can ask questions of the data in natural language and trust the answers. - Build interactive dashboards in Sigma, our strategic BI platform, while supporting existing Tableau reporting during the transition, working alongside Business Analysts and applying data storytelling principles that encourage self-service analytics. - Apply a data product mindset to everything you deliver, building reporting that is reusable, well-documented, and designed for long-term impact. - Partner with our Data Engineering team on upstream pipeline changes, investigate data issues through root-cause analysis, and help improve the platform we build on. - Work directly with stakeholders across Commercial, Finance, Compliance, Operations, Payments, Data Science, Marketing, and Product to understand their needs and translate them into well-designed data solutions. - Help harmonise KPIs and metric definitions across brands and BI platforms. - Champion data quality, documentation, and consistent metric definitions so people can trust what they see. - Keep learning, and share useful tools, techniques, and ideas with the team. WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR Essential: - 2-5 years of experience in a BI Engineering, Analytics Engineering, or similar role. - Advanced SQL, with a solid grasp of data modelling concepts (for example, dimensional modelling). - Hands-on experience with at least one modern BI tool, ideally Sigma or Tableau. - The ability to explain technical concepts clearly to non-technical colleagues and senior management. - Clear, concise written documentation that others can actually use. - A structured, curious approach to problem-solving and debugging data issues. Nice to have: - Experience in the iGaming industry (Sportsbook and/or Casino). - Python, Airflow, and dbt. - Experience with BigQuery or another cloud data warehouse, and with GCP more broadly. - Familiarity with Git and CI/CD workflows. - Exposure to Sigma WHO WE ARE At the core of LeoVegas Group is Team Leo. Our culture is our foundation and is what enables us to innovate, build, and lead as we trailblaze our way through the igaming industry. We’re a team of over 2000 innovators, initiators, and groundbreakers working in a fast-paced and agile environment across 19 offices worldwide. BENEFITS: - Hybrid work policy - 4 weeks of Workation (T&C apply) - 30 annual vacation days - Occupational Pension - 5,000 SEK wellness contribution annually - Parental Leave Top-Up - Possibility to enrol in a private health care insurance for both you and your partne - Benify - benefits portal with many offers and discounts JOIN US! In our pride, we empower our teammates to find their roar and run with their wildest ideas. We don’t wait for things to happen; we pounce and make it happen! Would you be a good fit for the Leo Pride - give us a roar! As our company working language is English, we’d like to see your CV in English, please

items.title: Research Engineer - Search and Services
items.description: ABOUT MISTRAL Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms. We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited. Role Summary We are seeking a talented and experienced Research Engineer to join our newly forming Search and Services Platform team within Research Platform. You will build and operate the large-scale search and services that our models rely on as tools — from self-hosted, web-scale, search indexes to knowledge graphs and databases served through MCP. You will work closely with researchers and with the pretraining data, sandbox and data platform teams to make these services reliable, scalable and fast, on infrastructure measured in hundreds of terabytes of NVMe storage and thousands of CPU cores to support both data generation and critical training runs. What you will do As a Research Engineer on the Search and Services team, your responsibilities will include (but may not be limited to): - Designing, building and operating large-scale search infrastructure: self-hosted Vespa clusters indexing web-scale corpora, managed indexes for smaller corpora, and vendor search endpoints. - Self-hosting and maintaining a wide range of structured data sources — knowledge graphs (Wikidata, UniProt, Materials Project), scholarly data (OpenAlex, OpenAIRE), statistical databases (Eurostat, World Bank, IMF, OECD), open data portals and more. - Designing interfaces and tools to expose to the models and agents to use the services in different ways (direct YQL or SPARQL queries, or more refined and constrained MCPs to mimic external services) to support data generation and agentic training. - Building the data pipelines that ingest, index and serve massive datasets, including indexing our own pretraining corpora for exploration, deduplication and eval-leakage checks. - Building strong relationships with researchers and adjacent teams (pretraining data,, sandbox, data platform), understanding their workflows and enabling them to achieve more by leveraging your expertise. - Communicating and producing documentation or any content that will help teams make the most of the services you'll build. About you - 5+ years of successful experience in search engineering, data infrastructure, or a similar SRE / platform role. - Proficiency in software development (Python, Go...) and programming best practices. - Hands-on experience with large-scale search or data systems (e.g. Vespa, Elasticsearch / OpenSearch, ClickHouse or similar). - Exposure to site reliability engineering: root cause analysis, in-production troubleshooting, on-call rotations...) - Exposure to infrastructure management: containerization, orchestration (Kubernetes), infra-as-code, monitoring, logging, alerting, observability...). - Experience designing and operating data pipelines that address large amounts of data. - Excellent problem-solving and communication skills (ability to contextualizing, gauging risks and getting buy-in for high stakes and impactful solutions). - Ownership, high agency and constantly seeking to learn and improving things for others. - Autonomous, self-driven and able to work well in a fast-paced startup environment. - Low ego and team spirit mindset. - Your application will be all the more interesting if you also have: - First-hand Vespa (or equivalent large-scale information retrieval) experience. - Experience building or operating MCP servers / tool-serving infrastructure for LLMs. - Familiarity with knowledge graphs, RDF / SPARQL, or large structured databases (PostgreSQL, ClickHouse, DuckDB...). - Experience with large bare-metal infrastructure or HPC environments. WHAT WE OFFER We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location-specific perks. For the most up-to-date details on benefits available in your location, please refer to our Benefits page https://app.notion.com/p/mistralai/Benefits-at-Mistral-36e6ba59a7fe836b93dd01737fcc27ef?source=copy_link. PRIVACY POLICY Your privacy matters to us. You can learn more about how we handle your personal data in our Applicant Privacy Policy https://legal.mistral.ai/terms/applicant-privacy-policy.

items.title: Product Marketing, Messaging Lead
items.description: About the Team OpenAI’s B2B Marketing team helps businesses understand, adopt, and get value from our products. We work closely with Product, Research, Sales, and Communications to connect advances in AI to the problems organizations are trying to solve. About the Role We’re looking for a Messaging Lead to shape how businesses understand OpenAI and the value of our portfolio. You’ll develop a clear enterprise narrative, connect individual product stories to it, and help explain how AI is changing the way people and organizations work. You’ll work directly with senior leaders and technical teams to make difficult positioning decisions and turn them into work that customers, executives, and the field can use. You’ll be a hands-on writer and editor as well as a strategic partner, responsible for the quality and coherence of our most important business stories. This is a senior individual contributor role, with the potential to build and lead a team as the function grows. In this role, you will: - Define and evolve the enterprise narrative and the messages that connect our products to customer needs and business outcomes. - Partner with product and industry marketers to make the portfolio clear and differentiated while preserving the depth each audience needs. - Translate complex capabilities into precise, compelling stories with Product and Research. - Personally develop core enterprise pitches, executive narratives, major launch messages, and other high-priority materials. - Bring customer insight, competitive context, and credible proof into the story with GTM and Customer Marketing. - Help Marketing, Communications, and Enablement apply the narrative, and improve it through customer feedback and testing. - Coach partners on messaging and writing, and help define how the function should grow. You might thrive in this role if you have: - 14+ years of experience in B2B product marketing, positioning, or messaging, with a track record of shaping enterprise narratives and translating complex technology portfolios into clear, differentiated stories for business audiences. - A track record of leading messaging, positioning, or product marketing for complex technology portfolios serving business customers. - Exceptional writing and editing skills, with examples of work you personally created and an ability to explain the decisions behind it. - Strong product and technical judgment, including the ability to distinguish a supported claim from an appealing assertion. - Experience working with senior executives and technical leaders, resolving conflicting views, and leading without formal authority. - Evidence that your narratives were adopted by customer-facing teams and improved customer understanding or evaluation. - The willingness to work hands-on, move through ambiguity, and revise your view when evidence changes. - Practical fluency with AI tools and thoughtful judgment about where human review matters. - Experience developing marketers or building a messaging function is valuable. Previous people-management experience is not required for the initial IC role. Workplace & Location This role is based in San Francisco, CA. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees. Occasional travel will be required. About OpenAI OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity. We are an equal opportunity employer, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. For additional information, please see OpenAI’s Affirmative Action and Equal Employment Opportunity Policy Statement https://cdn.openai.com/policies/eeo-policy-statement.pdf. Background checks for applicants will be administered in accordance with applicable law, and qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment consistent with those laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act, for US-based candidates. For unincorporated Los Angeles County workers: we reasonably believe that criminal history may have a direct, adverse and negative relationship with the following job duties, potentially resulting in the withdrawal of a conditional offer of employment: protect computer hardware entrusted to you from theft, loss or damage; return all computer hardware in your possession (including the data contained therein) upon termination of employment or end of assignment; and maintain the confidentiality of proprietary, confidential, and non-public information. In addition, job duties require access to secure and protected information technology systems and related data security obligations. To notify OpenAI that you believe this job posting is non-compliant, please submit a report through this form https://form.asana.com/?d=57018692298241&k=5MqR40fZd7jlxVUh5J-UeA. No response will be provided to inquiries unrelated to job posting compliance. We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations to applicants with disabilities, and requests can be made via this link https://form.asana.com/?k=bQ7w9h3iexRlicUdWRiwvg&d=57018692298241. OpenAI Global Applicant Privacy Policy https://cdn.openai.com/policies/global-employee-and-contractor-privacy-policy.pdf At OpenAI, we believe artificial intelligence has the potential to help people solve immense global challenges, and we want the upside of AI to be widely shared. Join us in shaping the future of technology.

items.title: Frontier Agent Engineering Manager, Enterprise
items.description: About Scale AI Scale AI is the data foundation for AI, helping organizations build and deploy reliable production AI applications. We partner with leading enterprises and government organizations to accelerate their AI initiatives through our data annotation platform, generative AI solutions, and enterprise AI capabilities. Role Overview As a Forward Deployed AI Engineering Manager on our Enterprise team, you'll be the technical bridge between Scale AI's cutting-edge AI capabilities and our most strategic customers. You'll work with enterprise clients to understand their unique challenges, lead a team that architects specific AI solutions, and ensure successful deployment and adoption of AI systems in production environments. This is a Management role that combines deep engineering and AI expertise, leading a team, and working on customer-facing problems. You'll work directly with customer engineering teams to integrate AI into their critical workflows. Key Responsibilities Customer Integration & Deployment Partner directly with enterprise customers to understand their technical infrastructure, data pipelines, and business requirements Design and implement custom integrations between Scale AI's platform and customer data environments (cloud platforms, data warehouses, internal APIs) Build robust data connectors and ETL pipelines to ingest, process, and prepare customer data for AI workflows Deploy and configure AI models and agents within customer security and compliance boundaries AI Agent Development Develop production-grade AI agents tailored to customer use cases across domains like customer support, data analysis, content generation, and workflow automation Architect multi-agent systems that orchestrate between different models, tools, and data sources Implement evaluation frameworks to measure agent performance and iterate toward business objectives Design human-in-the-loop workflows and feedback mechanisms for continuous agent improvement Prompt Engineering & Optimization Create sophisticated prompt engineering strategies optimized for customer-specific domains and data Build and maintain prompt libraries, templates, and best practices for customer use cases Conduct systematic prompt experimentation and A/B testing to improve model outputs Implement RAG (Retrieval Augmented Generation) systems and fine-tuning pipelines where appropriate Leadership & Collaboration Serve as the Engineering Manager and technical point of contact for strategic enterprise accounts Lead a team that is collaborating with customer data scientists, ML engineers, and software developers to ensure smooth integration Work closely with Scale's product and engineering teams to translate customer needs into product improvements Document technical architectures, integration patterns, and best practices Problem Solving & Innovation Debug complex technical issues across the entire stack, from data pipelines to model outputs Rapidly prototype solutions to unblock customers and prove out new use cases Stay current on the latest AI/ML research and tools, bringing innovative approaches to customer problems Identify opportunities for productization based on common customer patterns Required Qualifications 5+ years of software engineering experience with 3+ yrs of Management experience with strong fundamentals in data structures, algorithms, and system design Production Python expertise with experience in modern ML/AI frameworks (e.g., LangChain, LlamaIndex, HuggingFace, OpenAI API) Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure) and modern data infrastructure Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to navigate ambiguous requirements and rapidly iterate toward solutions Excellent communication skills with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences Preferred Qualifications Agent Development Wiz Deep understanding of LLMs including prompting techniques, embeddings, and RAG architectures Experience building and deploying AI agents or autonomous systems in production Knowledge of vector databases and semantic search systems Contributions to open-source AI/ML projects Infrastructure Guru Experience with containerization (Docker, Kubernetes) and CI/CD pipelines Experience using Terraform, Bicep, or other Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools Previous work in a devops, platform, or infra role Familiarity with enterprise security, compliance, and governance requirements (SOC 2, GDPR, HIPAA) Customer Product Whisperer Proven ability to work with customers in a technical consulting, solutions engineering, or product engineering role Domain expertise in verticals like finance, healthcare, government, or manufacturing Experience with technical enablement or teaching programs Sample Projects The following are some examples of the types of projects we’ve worked on with customers. All of these projects leverage customer data, integrate directly into customers’ existing systems, and are deployed on their infrastructure. Deep Research for Due Diligence For a global professional services firm, we developed a sophisticated deep research agent to assist in due diligence. This agent employs a multi-agent architecture for robust fact-checking, integrates several internal MCP tools, and processes complex, unstructured data sources. This solution reliably saves employees hundreds of hours weekly. Churn Prediction Working with a TelCo organization, we built a model utilizing customer data to predict churn likelihood. The system then curates personalized offers based on this prediction. This model was integrated into a "next best action" copilot, enabling call center agents to proactively surface relevant offers to customers, leading to a significant reduction in churn. Data Extraction Voice Agent We partnered with a healthcare organization to create a lifelike voice agent and avatar designed to gather unstructured health information from patients. Engineered for low latency, the agent adeptly manages conversational flow, adheres to safety guardrails, and efficiently handles data extraction. This automation saves the organization's nurses hundreds of hours each week. PLEASE NOTE: Our policy requires a 90-day waiting period before reconsidering candidates for the same role. This allows us to ensure a fair and thorough evaluation of all applicants. About Us: At Scale, our mission is to develop reliable AI systems for the world's most important decisions. Our products provide the high-quality data and full-stack technologies that power the world's leading models, and help enterprises and governments build, deploy, and oversee AI applications that deliver real impact. We work closely with industry leaders like Meta, Ernst & Young, Mayo Clinic, Time Inc., the Government of Qatar, and U.S. government agencies including the Army and Air Force. We are expanding our team to accelerate the development of AI applications. We believe that everyone should be able to bring their whole selves to work, which is why we are proud to be an inclusive and equal opportunity workplace. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability status, gender identity or Veteran status. We are committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodations to applicants with physical and mental disabilities. If you need assistance and/or a reasonable accommodation in the application or recruiting process due to a disability, please contact us at accommodations@scale.com. Please see the United States Department of Labor's Know Your Rights poster for additional information. We comply with the United States Department of Labor's Pay Transparency provision . PLEASE NOTE: We collect, retain and use personal data for our professional business purposes, including notifying you of job opportunities that may be of interest and sharing with our affiliates. We limit the personal data we collect to that which we believe is appropriate and necessary to manage applicants’ needs, provide our services, and comply with applicable laws. Any information we collect in connection with your application will be treated in accordance with our internal policies and programs designed to protect personal data. Please see our privacy policy for additional information.

items.description: Role Overview As the Senior Martech & Automation Manager, you will serve as a key conduit between the CRM, Marketing, and Product teams, maintaining a strong focus on core CRM operations. In this role, you will be responsible for configuring, managing, and optimizing our primary CRM and marketing automation platforms to support smooth campaign execution and reliable user engagement, ensuring we have the infrastructure and framework to enable personalisation and automation at scale. You will lead day-to-day CRM operational efforts, ensuring seamless journey setups, lifecycle campaign execution, and data accuracy across tools. Balancing regular execution with process improvements, you will assist team members with technical queries, resolve workflow bottlenecks, and keep CRM and marketing automation running efficiently across global markets. Key Responsibilities - Platform Administration & Operations: Manage the daily administration and health of our MarTech tools, maintaining clean data connections and reliable performance. - Bonus & Promotion Engine: Oversee development and adoption of internal bonus & promotional engines. - Dynamic Creative & AI Implementation: Help introduce and manage Dynamic Creative Optimization (DCO) platforms, dynamic content and AI creative tools, building logic and templates that streamline localized asset delivery. - CRM & Automation operations: Build, test, and launch automated multi-channel marketing workflows using complex personalisation logic, API triggers, and template scripting (Liquid). - Team Support & Enablement: Guide and support team members on Martech tools, helping marketing and CRM teams get the most out of the stack. - Team Management: Foster a positive, collaborative work environment while nurturing your team of automation & CRM technical specialists - Technical Support & Troubleshooting: Help troubleshoot technical bugs and data integration issues, collaborating with engineering teams when deeper technical fixes are needed. - Workflow Improvements: Identify operational bottlenecks in campaign setup and deploy practical automation to speed up campaign execution. - Attribute & Analytics: Partner with data and engineering teams to ensure accurate conversion tracking, user attribution, and compliant consent management. - Cross-Functional Collaboration: Translate marketing goals into technical requirements for product and dev teams. Key Skills & Qualifications - Experience: 4+ years of hands-on experience in Marketing Operations, CRM Technology, or MarTech execution, preferably in fast-paced sectors like iGaming, Fintech, or e-commerce. - Platform Expertise: Strong hands-on experience with CDPs, CRM Tools (e.g., Optimove, Braze) and exposure to DCO tools (e.g., Celtra, Bannerflow) and campaign AI tooling. - Technical Skills: Solid proficiency in templating languages (eg HTML/ Liquid), basic understanding of APIs and SQL, and strong technical problem-solving skills. - Practical Problem Solving: Pragmatic, detail-oriented approach to troubleshooting issues and optimizing operational workflows. - Project Delivery: Experience managing technical tasks in Agile settings (e.g., Jira, Monday.com http://Monday.com) and collaborating effectively across teams. Who We Are At the core of LeoVegas Group is Team Leo. Our culture is our foundation and is what enables us to innovate, build, and lead as we trailblaze our way through the igaming industry. We’re a team of over 2000 innovators, initiators, and groundbreakers working in a fast-paced and agile environment across 19 offices worldwide. Benefits - Hybrid work policy - 4 weeks of Workation (T&C apply) - Well-being allowance to support your active lifestyle - Private health insurance - Discounts across a range of retailers, gyms, bars & restaurants - We offer an employee assistance program that can provide help and guidance during challenging moments CALL TO ACTION In our pride, we empower our teammates to find their roar and run with their wildest ideas. We don’t wait for things to happen; we pounce and make it happen! Would you be a good fit for the Leo Pride – give us a roar!
